title: CS2023 defines algorithm design and analysis as foundational competencies
locator: Algorithmic Foundations (AL), Preamble and Knowledge Units
paraphrase: CS2023 treats computational problem solving, algorithm design, fundamental data structures and algorithms, correctness-oriented reasoning, searching, sorting, and analysis of computational trade-offs as core algorithmic foundations.
scope: Curriculum evidence for Volume 01 problem definition, pseudocode, tracing, searching, sorting, and complexity concepts; it does not prescribe one programming language.
